story.title: Claude Mythos Puts India on Alert: CERT-In, Banks and Telcos Assess Unprecedented Zero-Day Cyber Risks
story.summary: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview AI model has identified thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities in widely used web browsers and operating systems, triggering a national security response in India. CERT-In, major banks, and telecom operators including Airtel and Vi have been activated to assess their exposure to the newly discovered attack surface. The development signals that AI-powered vulnerability discovery has reached a scale where traditional patch-and-respond security cycles may no longer be adequate for Indian enterprises and critical infrastructure.
